freshInspection.objective: Determine whether the current OWASP/security scope requires domain model, invariant or contract changes before proceeding to persistence/API/security testing.
observedDomainSecurityContracts: ContextoTenantActual cannot be created from unverified client claims; its public factory requires an active UsuarioEmpresa membership and exposes a fail-closed ExigirEmpresa tenant guard.
UsuarioEmpresa validates positive user/company/role identifiers, resolves effective role only for matching active membership, and scopes that role to one Empresa.

The API tenant context requires a positive X-Empresa-Id, while the application permission service resolves and verifies the authenticated user's actual tenant membership before relational permission checks.
The Domain project remains dependency-minimal and contains no transport, secret, proxy, rate-limit, upload or dependency-scanning concerns that should be pulled into domain entities.
freshInspection.causalConclusion: No new domain model or invariant change is required for N8.11. Current tenant/membership invariants already fail closed and the remaining security risks from N8.11.A belong to API/application/infrastructure/configuration/test stages. Adding speculative domain state would increase coupling without closing a demonstrated gap.

downstreamRouting.N8.11.C: verify persistence constraints/migrations/backfill/indexes and tenant data integrity
downstreamRouting.N8.11.G: causal vulnerability, negative-authz, malformed-upload and CI tests

freshInspection.testApplicability: No code delta was made in DOMAIN; compile/regression is not causally required solely to certify the N/A domain delta. Existing invariant source was inspected fresh and later causal tests must exercise it through application/API consumers.
freshInspection.rollback: Not applicable: no product or schema write was performed.
